metadata.title: XtremLib3
metadata.description:
Provides functions (cmdlets) to manipulate the XtremIO clusters.
	More information here:
	XtremIO: Useful Guides and Best Practices
	PowerShell API Guide
	https://www.dell.com/support/kbdoc/en-us/487371

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'GetXtremAuthHeader' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
